assertions.subject: Appendiceal Stump Abscess
assertions.quote: Approximately 9.4% of patients who undergo appendectomy for complicated appendicitis will develop a postoperative pelvic abscess

assertions.subject: Appendiceal Stump Abscess
assertions.quote: Stump appendicitis, a form of recurrent appendicitis, may occur when an inadequate amount of appendiceal tissue is resected

assertions.subject: Appendiceal Stump Abscess
assertions.quote: Stump appendicitis, a form of recurrent appendicitis, may occur when an inadequate amount of appendiceal tissue is resected, and a long stump is left behind

assertions.subject: Appendiceal Stump Abscess
assertions.quote: Resection of adequate appendiceal tissue with less than 5 mm of stump preservation is recommended to minimize risk
